# Net Infotech System Pvt. Ltd.

> Net Infotech System Pvt. Ltd. (NISPL) is Eastern India's premier IT solutions provider and Tally 3-Star Certified Partner. With over 25 years of excellence, NISPL provides enterprise cloud hosting, custom software development, cybersecurity, hardware infrastructure, and managed IT services.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://nispl.netlify.app/): Main web portal showcasing enterprise IT services, cloud hosting, certified technology partners, and verified client testimonials.
- [About Us](https://nispl.netlify.app/about): Company legacy, leadership, corporate milestones, 25+ years of industry track record, and operational values.
- [Contact & Support](https://nispl.netlify.app/contact): Official contact directory, branch offices in Kolkata, Burdwan, and Durgapur, inquiry form, and enterprise ticketing.
- [Careers](https://nispl.netlify.app/career): Job openings, engineering and consulting opportunities, work culture, and online application portal.

## Enterprise Services & Solutions

- [Tally Prime Solutions & Cloud Hosting](https://nispl.netlify.app/): Certified Tally implementation, custom TDL module development, multi-user deployment, and high-speed Tally-on-Cloud hosting.
- [Enterprise Cloud & Hosting (AWS, Azure, CtrlS)](https://nispl.netlify.app/): Cloud migration, scalable virtual machines, data backup, and hybrid cloud management.
- [Cybersecurity & Threat Defense](https://nispl.netlify.app/): Next-generation firewall implementation, endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, and disaster recovery.
- [Managed IT Services & AMC Support](https://nispl.netlify.app/): 24/7 server monitoring, proactive maintenance, network uptime guarantees, and on-site engineering dispatch.
- [Hardware & Networking Infrastructure](https://nispl.netlify.app/): Authorized enterprise partnerships with HP, Lenovo, Canon, CP PLUS, and D-Link for procurement and SLA maintenance.

## Discoverability & Metadata

- [Sitemap](https://nispl.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML sitemap for search crawlers and AI agents.
- [Robots Configuration](https://nispl.netlify.app/robots.txt): Web crawler directives and sitemap declaration.
- [AI Agent Catalog](https://nispl.netlify.app/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable service and agent catalog specification.
